主要内容: Westinghouse Air Brake Technologies Corporation completed the purchase of 7,475,537 ordinary shares of Faiveley Transport, representing approximately 51% of its outstanding share capital, under the Share Purchase Agreement dated October 6, 2015. The transaction involved approximately $212 million in cash and 6.3 million shares of WAB common stock. Wabtec France will file a mandatory tender offer to acquire the remaining shares of Faiveley Transport, with the total purchase price expected to reach approximately $1.7 billion, including assumed debt. The common stock used as consideration was issued under Section 4(a)(2) and/or Regulation S of the Securities Act of 1933. The acquisition led to the election of Philippe Alfroid and Erwan Faiveley to the Board of Directors of WAB on November 30, 2016, as per the Shareholders Agreement. The transaction is subject to the terms and conditions of the Tender Offer Agreement dated October 6, 2015, as amended.
